# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Text — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 41 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 12 tokens; Radius — 2 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Medidas — 8 tokens; Gradiente — 2 tokens.

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--texto, #1e2020);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--texto, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #1e2020;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--texto` | #1e2020 | #ffffff | Texto principal sobre `fondo`, `fondo-alterno`, `superficie` y `superficie-hundida`. |
| `--texto-suave` | #666666 | #b5b9b9 | Texto secundario, antetítulos, notas y ayudas sobre `fondo`, `fondo-alterno`, `superficie` y `superficie-hundida` (5.3:1 o más en claro, 7.0:1 o más en oscuro). |
| `--texto-inverso` | #ffffff | #1e2020 | Texto sobre un bloque del tono contrario al tema. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one. Poppins. Tipo oración; alineado a la izquierda. Lato. Medida de 60 a 75 caracteres; nunca justificado.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 72px/1.08 'Poppins',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em;
font-family: var(--font-titulos);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 72px / 1.08, letter-spacing -0.01em | 600 | `titulos` | Portadas. Fluido en la fuente: clamp(44px,6vw,72px), clase `sl-display`; aquí va el tope. |
| `titulo-1` | `.titulo-1`, `--text-titulo-1` | 52px / 1.12 | 600 | `titulos` | Título de página. Fluido: clamp(36px,4.4vw,52px), clase `sl-titulo-1`. |
| `titulo-2` | `.titulo-2`, `--text-titulo-2` | 38px / 1.18 | 600 | `titulos` | Título de sección, con la firma una vez por bloque. Fluido: clamp(28px,3.2vw,38px), clase `sl-titulo-2`. |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/lato-300-italic.woff2`, `fonts/lato-400-italic.woff2`, `fonts/lato-300.woff2`, `fonts/lato-400.woff2`, `fonts/lato-700.woff2`, `fonts/poppins-400.woff2`, `fonts/poppins-500.woff2` and `fonts/poppins-600.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/lato-300-italic.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/lato-300-italic.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lato | `fonts/lato-400.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-texto)` | `lato` |
| Poppins | `fonts/poppins-400.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-titulos)` | `poppins` |

Every face: `fonts/lato-300-italic.woff2` (Lato, 300, italic), `fonts/lato-400-italic.woff2` (Lato, 400, italic), `fonts/lato-300.woff2` (Lato, 300), `fonts/lato-400.woff2` (Lato, 400), `fonts/lato-700.woff2` (Lato, 700), `fonts/poppins-400.woff2` (Poppins, 400), `fonts/poppins-500.woff2` (Poppins, 500), `fonts/poppins-600.woff2` (Poppins, 600).

## Spacing

Escala de 4 a 96px.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (12)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Separación mínima entre filas de un aviso. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Entre ícono y texto en botones y enlaces; entre etiqueta y control. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Relleno horizontal de campos y fichas; entre casilla y etiqueta. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Relleno de celdas de tabla y de avisos; entre partes de una tarjeta. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Relleno horizontal de botones, avisos y notificaciones. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Margen lateral del contenedor; relleno de diálogos; entre pestañas. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Relleno de tarjetas; separación entre columnas de la retícula. |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Espacio reservado para la flecha del selector. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Relleno del bloque liso sobre el patrón. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Espacio vertical entre secciones en móvil. |

## Gradiente

Degradados de marca para fondos: franjas, portadas, diapositivas, publicaciones y tarjetas. Nunca bajo texto suelto: el texto va en un bloque liso.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--gradiente-marca: linear-gradient(120deg,#008C99 0%,#00D1B1 100%)) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--gradiente-marca), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--gradiente-marca` | linear-gradient(120deg,#008C99 0%,#00D1B1 100%) | Fondo de alto impacto: franjas, portadas, diapositivas de marca, publicaciones y barra de métricas. Texto solo en bloques lisos encima. |
| `--gradiente-profundo` | linear-gradient(160deg,#1E2020 0%,#005E67 100%) | Fondo oscuro: reverso de tarjeta, franja profunda y tono de la imagen duotono. Texto blanco solo en bloques lisos. |
